title: Harden Login register redirect URL resolution
completion_summary: Hardened register URL resolution with ASTRO_APP_URL override, locale-aware path, and safe fallback to Keycloak registration URL.
acceptance_criteria: Register link uses ASTRO_APP_URL when present and non-empty.
Locale segment is preserved in register redirect path.
When ASTRO_APP_URL is missing, redirect fallback remains public behavior without runtime error.
